redirects.//: Short alias for the printed visiting card. The QR encodes /CARD in uppercase (alphanumeric QR mode is ~5.5 bits/char vs 8 for byte mode, which is what keeps the symbol at 25 modules instead of 29). URL paths are case-sensitive per RFC 3986, so the character class matches all 16 casings explicitly rather than relying on the matcher's default sensitivity. Kept as a temporary redirect: a printed card cannot be reissued, so the destination must stay repointable and must not be cached permanently by browsers.

Ashish Narayan's personal card, printed as indizilla.com/ANC and typed by hand, so every casing has to land. The destination is deliberately NOT any casing of /anc: a redirect whose target matches its own source loops forever. Temporary for the same reason as /card — the printed URL must stay repointable.

headers.//: Served as a contact card rather than an unknown download, so phones open it in the contacts app instead of dropping a file the recipient has to find and tap again.
